page.layout: One page of text, full width. Running head at top with page number at top left. Continuation paragraph from the previous page, then a centred heading and a new paragraph with a large initial M, running to the foot.

main_text.p: ditissime[?] Candidate, D. HARDI, de hisce Anabaptistarum & aliorum, scripturis sanctis abstentium, sophisticis rationibus, ac veluti aranearum telis καὶ λεπτολογουμένοις, vi-deatur, toti huic ornatissimae Concioni innotescere & constare possit, propono tibi hoc Problema, ἀναλογικῶς[?], pro egregia tua doctrina enucleandum & exponendum: Anne veteris & noui Testamenti discrimen aliquod ἰσωνάλις[?] ideò à nobis constitui debeat, quòd Apostolus Paulus (Heb.10.1.) illi quidem vmbram futurorum bonorum tribuit, huic autem expressam formam & veritatem, necne?
main_text.head: RESPONSIO D. IOHANNIS HARDII, AD PROBLEMA DE VETERIS & NOVI TESTAMENTI DISCRIMINE.
main_text.p: Magnifice D. Rector, viri clarissimi, Patres Academici, Nobiles virtute & ingenijs florentes, Concio amplissima & spectatissima: Quum, de vnico illo et aeterno Dei Testamento ac diuina gratia foedere, in Schola huius Christianae solemni conuentu, facienda mihi paucis & sententiosè verba animaduerterem: venit mihi in mentem Pho-

page.notes: Page number printed as "2i6" (the 1 is set as i). Greek words in the first paragraph and "ἀναλογικῶς" and "ἰσωνάλις" are uncertain readings; check against the scan. "ditissime" at the start is a fragment from the previous page and the first letter is doubtful. Catchword "tionis" stands at the lower right.
